_comment: CLUSTER 1b -- THE LOOP DOES NOT START AT ALL (zero blinks, zero events).
One card apart from sweep_1: a SECOND Conservatory. sweep_1's loop runs 31 blinks and simply
never draws; add one more draw land and the loop stops running entirely -- the apply emits no
history at all and the opponent is untouched, while the plan promised a long blink chain.
MEASURED on this exact board (test/combo_off_sweep.py A/B):
Living Wish in LIBRARY   (this fixture)   ->  0 blinks, NO WIN
Living Wish in HAND                       -> 10 blinks, WINS
Living Wish in library + Infiltrator HAND -> 10 blinks, WINS
Living Wish in library + Infiltrator BF   -> 10 blinks, WINS
so the trigger is exactly !ComboFinisherReachable -- ApplyBlinkLoop's `want_draw`, which also
drives the draw-land untap promotion. The iteration body spends on the draw sinks BEFORE it
pays the activation:
if (cash_sinks && want_draw) { SpendSurplusOnDrawSinks(state, controller, c, pay); }
if (untaps > 0)             { EtbUntapTapAheadIntoFloat(...); }
if (!pay(c))                { break; }        <-- k == 0, done == 0
The extra draw land is what tips it: with three promoted draw sinks the untap priority set
holds nothing but low-yield lands, so the tap-ahead banks too little float to pay {2}{C}.
That is the Session 14b failure shape exactly ('every draw land was promoted above every
yield and not one of them was ever activated'), on the spend side rather than the promotion
side.
EXPECTED TO FAIL until the fix lands.
